tangentLinesEx.name: Tangent Lines (Ex)
tangentLinesEx.desc: Create external tangent lines between circles.

tangentLinesIn.name: Tangent Lines (In)
tangentLinesIn.desc: Create internal tangent lines between circles.

treeBranch.name: Tree Branch
treeBranch.desc: Retrieve a specific branch from a data tree.

treeItem.name: Tree Item
treeItem.desc: Retrieve a specific item from a data tree.

trimSolid.name: Trim Solid
trimSolid.desc: Cut holes into a shape with a set of solid cutters.

trimTree.name: Trim Tree
ins: Number of outermost branches to merge
trimTree.desc: Reduce the complexity of a tree by merging the outermost branches.

trimWithBrep.name: Trim with Brep
trimWithBrep.desc: Trim a curve with a Brep.

trimWithBreps.name: Trim with Breps
outs: Split curves on the inside of the trimming Breps
Split curves on the outside of the trimming Breps
trimWithBreps.desc: Trim a curve with multiple Breps.

trimWithRegion.name: Trim with Region
ins: Optional solution plane. If omitted the curve best-fit plane is used
trimWithRegion.desc: Trim a curve with a region.

truncate.name: Truncate
ins: Truncation factor. Must be between 0.0 (no trucation) and 1.0 (full truncation)

unflattenTree.name: Unflatten Tree
ins: Guide data tree that defines the path layout
unflattenTree.desc: Unflatten a data tree by moving items back into branches.

unitY.name: Unit Y
unitY.desc: Unit vector parallel to the world {y} axis.

untrim.name: Untrim
untrim.desc: Remove all trim curves from a surface.

valueList.name: Value List
valueList.desc: Provides a list of preset values to choose from.

vectorLength.name: Vector Length
vectorLength.desc: Compute the length (amplitude) of a vector.

volume.name: Volume
ins: Closed brep or mesh for volume computation
volume.desc: Solve volume properties for closed breps and meshes.

weave.name: Weave
weave.desc: Weave a set of input data using a custom pattern.
